rule: CRITERIA C8 as amended (AMENDMENT-2026-11-24 section 1): reported from the reference alone, not claimed. Each rung's gap is taken at its largest pair, the largest |gap| over S@pool and S@lumen at the observation times (ties to S@pool, then the earliest time); resolution = |gap| / (SD / sqrt(128)). The slope on ln|gap| against ln N_g is fitted from the reference files' gap lists by the checker: the references fit nothing (SPEC.md section 4)
slope_se_note: the standard error of a least-squares slope of ln|gap| on ln N_g over all rungs if each rung's ln|gap| were measured with SD 1/resolution (linearised; meaningless where a resolution is below about 3)
